Take it with you

Install the app

Put Dismeigh on your home screen. It opens full screen like a regular app, with the stream schedule, clips and garage one tap away. It’s free and takes about 10 seconds.

You’re all set. You’re already using the Dismeigh app.

Your browser can install it right now:

  1. 1

    Open the site in Safari

    Go to denizen-dismeigh.com in Safari, the iPhone’s built-in browser.

  2. 2

    Tap the Share button

    It’s the square with an arrow pointing up, at the bottom of the screen (top right on iPad).

  3. 3

    Tap “Add to Home Screen”

    Scroll down the list of options to find it. You may need to tap “Edit Actions” if it’s hidden.

  4. 4

    Tap “Add”

    It’s in the top right corner. The Dismeigh icon lands on your home screen.

Using Chrome on your iPhone? Tap the Share icon in the address bar, then “Add to Home Screen.”

  1. 1

    Open the site in Chrome

    Go to denizen-dismeigh.com in Chrome.

  2. 2

    Tap the menu

    The three dots (⋮) in the top right corner.

  3. 3

    Tap “Install app”

    On some phones it says “Add to Home screen” instead.

  4. 4

    Tap “Install”

    The Dismeigh icon lands on your home screen and in your app drawer.

Using Samsung Internet? Tap the menu (≡), then “Add page to,” then “Home screen.”

  1. 1

    Open the site in Chrome or Edge

    Safari and Firefox on computers don’t support installing sites as apps.

  2. 2

    Click the install icon

    It’s at the right end of the address bar: a small screen with a down arrow.

  3. 3

    Click “Install”

    Dismeigh opens in its own window and shows up with your other apps.

No icon in the address bar? Open the browser menu and look for “Install” (Chrome: under “Cast, save and share”; Edge: under “Apps”).

What you get

  • Opens full screen, no browser bars
  • Shortcuts to the schedule and channel lore (press and hold the icon)
  • Always up to date, nothing to update from an app store
  • Works with a bad signal: shows an offline screen instead of an error

To remove it later, delete it like any other app.

See you next session.
